pattern-path-help-v2: Look at the stones along the trail and find the rule. Tap a stone below to fill the gap. Tap Help once to hear the rule, and a second time if you want to see the missing stone. In Challenge, fill every gap and press Check when you are ready.
pattern-path-say-rule: First choose the rule card that explains the pattern, then pick the missing stone, and tap Check.
pattern-path-two-gaps: This trail has two missing stones. Tap each glowing gap to fill it, then tap Check.
shape-shift-help-v2: Pick any piece from the tray. Tap Turn or Flip, then drag it onto the exact spot in the outline, or tap a square. Tap a placed piece to lift it back. Switch to Tangrams at the top whenever you like.
shape-shift-tangram-intro: Fit the seven Tangram shapes inside the shadow outline. Turn or flip a piece, then drop it right where it belongs.
shape-shift-cube-folds: Picture folding each net into a closed cube. Only one net folds with all six sides covered and no overlap.
